# Deck3 Cross-Stage Weakness-Learning Standard V1
**Effective:** 2026-10-09 | **Binding:** Deck3 text, figures, AI images, scientific diagrams, math graphics, assembly, QA and final presentation review.
**Basis:** Three submitted 13-slide Chapter 1 variants and their high-rigor comparison. The reference critiques presentation science and execution quality; it is not primary scientific authority or evidence of model validation.

## Central rule
Frozen scope is a research boundary, NOT validated science. Preserve Power (P) and full Electrified Transportation (T_e), extreme-heat thermal-interdependency only, physical state and time, electricity/mobility services, resilience, two sustainability pathways and measured-indicator-to-SDG-target interpretation. Treat every proposed mechanism, parameter, comparison model, law and research result as evidence-testable and revisable. Do not reward mere repetition of frozen language as scientific validation.

## Strengths to keep; weaknesses to close
A: Keep precise AC interface, physical energy conservation, separate common heat vs directional effects, clear service/resilience and both sustainability pathways. Fix insufficient full-text prior-art evidence, dense slides, missing equipment-specific data and nonspecific experiments/falsification.
B: Keep physically recognizable directional mechanism paths and study-specific comparison. Fix ordinary EV load incorrectly called thermal T_e→P; unsupported transformer thermal constraint→curtailment rule; prematurely frozen independent/static/dynamic M0/M1/M2; weak parameter identification and impact measurement.
C: Keep concise one-claim-per-slide copy, system≠active-case≠model-state distinction, readable RQ→SO→contribution progression. Fix omission of explicit AC/DC accounting, incomplete equipment-based mathematics/experimental strategy, oversimplified sustainability pathways and imported website/favicons mistaken for references.

## Universal gate before any Deck3 output
For EACH claim and object label, identify: what physical source/receiver exists; what exact quantity and unit crosses a boundary; external forcing vs dynamic state vs capability vs electricity or mobility service; whether a mechanism is ELECTRICAL_ONLY, THERMAL_CANDIDATE, PHYSICS_QUALIFIED, MEASURED, or VALIDATED. Require adjacent verified source attribution for external claims. A convincing illustration does not prove scientific evidence. Show explicit OPEN for unevidenced thermal operating policies or dataset variables.

### Stage 1 — Text (Dossiya Writing + Research Expert)
- One scientific audience message, up to three focused supports where the approved baseline allows; exact GO/SO1–SO3 and official title unaffected.
- For literature/gap claims, cite precisely audited full-text source and declare source access depth; no 'novel' until closest-comparator audit. Never paste web result fragments, website favicon references, or source logos.
- Define a testable research question, candidate mechanism, null alternative, observation needed, and explicitly acknowledged blocker where relevant.
- Slide-specific role: background (electrical connections not thermal causality); extreme heat (parallel external forcing); research problem (two independent candidate directional effects); literature (equations/data/validation matrix); full P/T_e boundary and grid-side AC interface; proposed model & numerical/empirical checks; required service; two sustainability pathways and SDG target interpretation.
- Preserve native editable text, real adjacent author–date citations, concise copy and 13-slide baseline unless explicitly changed. Do not generate a visually dominant figure slot on a legitimately text-led objectives/references slide.

### Stage 2 — Figures / AI Image / Scientific Diagrams
- Choose medium by function BEFORE generation: original realistic/photorealistic engineering image for hardware/spatial physical mechanisms; separate editable native PPTX for source matrices, RQs, methods, comparisons, sustainability/SDG maps, trajectories, and mathematical operators. A hybrid may combine real-equipment imagery with native scientific interfaces/labels.
- Realistic objects must have physically credible placement and connection. Label grid-side AC interface with measurement quantity; distinguish grid power supply from charger temperature-conditioned grid-side AC demand response. Separate heat lanes; never show P↔T_e thermal bidirectionality as established by mirrored arrows.
- No giant embedded captions, explanatory panels, component-functions tables, arrow legends, bullet cards, text-heavy infographics, or artificial results inside AI imagery. Essential on-scene scientific labels only; citations, equations, thresholds and literature references editable outside image.
- 13 approved sRGB colors for *authored* strokes and outlines, white canvas/panel; authentic photographic object color exception only for truly photo-like components. No decorative gradients/textures, glows, or shadows in authored diagrams.
- Physical/electrical/thermal arrows must be source→receiver labeled with meaning and evidence status and recorded in mechanism trace when applicable; scientific graphics cannot invent control laws, source evidence, temperature limits or data values.

### Stage 3 — Assembly / animation / accessible export
- Restore each approved text string, equation, citation, notes and case-status exactly; do not shrink scientific text to fake the requested 75% visual occupancy. Layout meaningful content not padded raster. Slides without justified images remain text-led.
- Where progressive reveals are requested and actually supported, animate real independently editable objects/edges; an embedded PNG is ONE object. Sequence system/ports→real interface→heat/state→conditional mechanism→outputs and interpretation.
- Reject wrong arrows, unverified power directions, off-palette authored colors, image panels, microtext, distorted aspect ratios, and wrong evidence status. Preserve a static readable fallback.

### Scientific questions that must be visible in the full deck
1. What real equipment and AC interface? 2. Which full-text studies and equations already exist? 3. What is the specific temperature-conditioned cross-system mechanism, rather than ordinary load/shared heat? 4. What measurements/parameters/thermal laws make it admissible? 5. What held-constant inputs, comparator and falsification condition distinguish an effect? 6. How is code verified, a physical prediction independently validated and its uncertainty quantified? 7. What are the units/requirements/timing of electricity and mobility services? 8. What environmental/economic/social measured indicators follow, and what EXACT SDG targets (if any) can be cautiously interpreted?
SDGs never omitted: SDG 7,9,11,13 are potential targets ONLY. Project indicators do not equal UN official indicators by similarity of wording.

## Cross-skill dispatch
Deck3 SKILL.md must invoke this reference for all stages. Dossiya Research Expert owns research evidence; Dossiya Writing owns natural scientific text; infographic/diagram/math/engineering skills own source-to-visual translation and geometry; advanced PowerPoint and runtime own editable layout, tests and honest release claims. None may override current thesis evidence authorities.

## Acceptance labels and testing
SCIENTIFIC_SOURCE_CHECK, TEXT_COPY_CHECK, PHYSICAL_INTERFACE_CHECK, THERMAL_CAUSAL_GATE, SDG_INDICATOR_GATE, FIGURE_PANEL_REJECTION, SVG_COLOR_SOURCE_QA, MECHANISM_TRACE, NATIVE_PPTX_TEXT_COLOR_QA, LAYOUT_RENDER_QA, ANIMATION_PLAYBACK. Distinguish PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN / OPEN, and SOURCE_GUIDANCE_ONLY vs RENDERED_VERIFIED vs PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED. A GitHub instruction change never retroactively fixes old PPTX/figures. No slide, PNG, paper audit or numerical study is created by this document.
